About the Platform

Built for aspiring
Chartered Surveyors

Get Chartered AI is a structured APC preparation platform built by Chartered Surveyors who have been through the process themselves.

Twelve modules in total. Module 1 sets the foundation — the APC framework, what assessors actually evaluate and how the submission works. Modules 2 to 11 cover every mandatory competency in depth. Module 12 brings it all together — revision, mock tests and a full 60-minute AI-scored mock interview across all 22 RICS pathways.

The platform doesn't just give you content to read. It builds the way you think, speak and evidence your experience — because that's what the APC actually tests. Most candidates who are referred know their subject. What separates those who pass is the ability to demonstrate it clearly, under pressure, in the format assessors score.

Alongside every module, meet Michael — your AI Tutor.

Michael is not a chatbox. He is a coaching presence that runs through the entire programme. In Tutor Mode he meets you where you are — asking you about a real situation from your working life, helping you shape it into competency evidence, naming the level of every answer and making the gap feel bridgeable. In Assessor Mode he challenges you exactly as the panel will — directly, without softening, with the follow-up questions you were not expecting.

"Warm when you are learning. Exacting when you are ready to be tested. Two modes. One goal."

  • All 11 RICS mandatory competencies covered in full
  • Michael — Tutor Mode and Assessor Mode, scope expands as you progress
  • Level 1, 2 and 3 competency examples throughout
  • 900+ pathway questions across all 22 RICS pathways
  • 60-minute AI-scored mock interview — all 22 pathways
  • Built and updated by experienced Chartered Surveyors

Meet Michael

Your AI Tutor. Available every time you need him.

Most APC candidates revise content but never practise performing under pressure. Michael closes that gap — available 24 hours a day, seven days a week, in two distinct modes.

Tutor Mode
For learning and understanding

Ask questions, explore competencies, get explanations. Michael meets you where you are — patient, thorough, never rushed. Use him alongside every module throughout your preparation.

Assessor Mode
For pressure testing

Michael switches. He asks the questions assessors ask. He follows up. He probes. He will not let a vague answer pass. Use him when you think you are ready — and find out if you really are.

Why Get Chartered AI

What changes when you prepare properly.

Every element of this platform is built around one question: what does a candidate need to walk in confident and come out chartered.

🎯

Stop wasting time on generic content

Every lesson, quiz and question is built specifically for the RICS APC — pure preparation at every competency level.

⏱

Study around a full working week

No live sessions, no fixed schedule. Your progress is saved automatically — pick up exactly where you left off, however busy the week gets.

📅

Walk in knowing what your assessor will probe

Every module current for 2026 — BSR independence, Renters Rights Act, RICS AI Standard, capital allowances and more.

🎓

Get challenged the way your assessor will

Michael is available any time — coaching, answer improvement and assessor-style challenge across every module you unlock.

Know exactly where your gaps are before it counts

Every module ends with a scored quiz — answers revealed after submission so every question becomes a learning moment.

Practise performing under pressure before it matters

A timed AI-scored mock interview across your specific pathway — the closest thing to the real assessment without sitting in the room.

🗺️

Your pathway. Your questions. Your preparation.

Revision and mock interview tailored to your specific RICS pathway — not a generic tool built for someone else.

Prepared by people who sat in the same room
